principle: One canonical Beta Program destination with non-sensitive public source-page attribution only.
coverageRule: Visible HTML filenames ending in index.html, including _index.html and common inndex.html typos, receive the canonical Beta doorway unless explicitly archived/private or unable to execute scripts by design.
continuousEnforcement: Each covered repository has a Beta index coverage GitHub Action that scans index surfaces on push and adds the canonical same-origin widget when missing.

summary.note: Administration, archives/private paths, and the Beta destination itself may be intentionally excluded. High School main remains intentionally unchanged.
